.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate
    :tickets: 1876

    Fixed issue where dialect-specific keyword arguments on a
    :class:`.ForeignKeyConstraint`, :class:`.ForeignKey` or
    :class:`.CheckConstraint`, such as ``postgresql_not_valid``, were not
    rendered for the constraints that are part of an autogenerated
    :meth:`.Operations.create_table` directive, nor for an autogenerated
    :meth:`.Operations.create_check_constraint` directive.  The
    :meth:`.Operations.create_table` case additionally requires SQLAlchemy
    2.0.55 / 2.1.5 or greater, which include the fix for SQLAlchemy issue
    #13677 where these arguments were lost when the :class:`.Table` was
    copied.
